methodology.asOf: All numeric factors use information available by the T-1 close; Nasdaq uses the latest US close strictly before T-1.
methodology.safetyCoverage: Trailing median Strategy B bond gain from the latest 60 Shenzhen bonds already exited before the current T-1, divided by stock cash required.
methodology.conversionValue: 100 × unadjusted stock T-1 close ÷ initial conversion price.
methodology.issueConversionPremium: Issue price ÷ T-1 conversion value − 1. This is a pre-listing issue-price proxy, not a tradable market premium.
methodology.marketAverageBondPrice: Arithmetic mean of unadjusted T-1 closes for all observable listed public convertible bonds in Shanghai and Shenzhen; the companion median and cross-sectional bond count are published per event. Factor bins use full-sample quartiles and are descriptive, not trading thresholds.
methodology.themeProxy: Stock five-session return minus the matching Shenzhen board-index five-session return; currentThemes are descriptive only and excluded from scoring to prevent look-ahead.
methodology.supportScore: One point each for conversion value 100–110, issue scale at least CNY 1bn, CSI 300 five-session return non-negative, and trailing safety coverage at least 2%.
methodology.caveat: Univariate historical grouping, not a causal model or investment recommendation.

sources: Existing audited backtest dataset and Tencent unadjusted stock daily bars
Eastmoney convertible-bond static issue table (initial conversion price, issue scale, rating)
Tencent unadjusted daily closes for the cross-sectional Shanghai/Shenzhen convertible-bond market average at each T-1; Eastmoney per-bond value-analysis history fills provider-wide archive gaps only
Tencent CSI 300, Shenzhen Component, ChiNext, Nasdaq Composite and S&P 500 daily index bars
Eastmoney current issuer industry/theme labels (descriptive only)

marketAveragePriceAudit.missingValuePolicy: No forward-fill or interpolation; an all-market provider gap is rebuilt from Eastmoney per-bond closes.
